title_original: 제주4ㆍ3사건 진상규명 및 희생자명예회복에 관한 특별법에 의한 가족관계 등록사무처리규칙
full_text:
Article 4 (Application Procedures for Creation, etc. of Family Relationship Registers)
(1) A person who intends to apply for creation, etc. of a family relationship register shall submit an application for creation (correction) of the family relationship register. <Amended on December 29, 2023>
(2) The application under paragraph (1) shall be accompanied by written recognition by the Committee that the person concerned is a victim: Provided, That where a bereaved family member applies, written recognition that the applicant is a bereaved family member shall also be attached.
(3) Deleted. <December 29, 2023>
